turns.reply: Kabir, yeh bahut bhaari lag raha hai. Aap abhi theek hain?
Kabir, kripya abhi kisi trusted adult—parent ya teacher—ko batayiye. Agar khud ko nuksan ka khayal ho, 1098 ya 14416 par call kijiye.

Aapne mujhe batakar bilkul sahi kiya. Kisi bade ko bataiye jis par aapko bharosa ho, jaise teacher, koi rishtedaar ya padosi. Childline 1098 par kabhi bhi free call kar sakte hain. Mann ki pareshani ke liye Tele-MANAS 14416 hai. Kya aap abhi theek hain?
